title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Evolutionary Policy Optimization for Preference-Adjustable Heterogeneous Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2608.24470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Heterogeneous agile Earth observation satellite (AEOS) scheduling requires task selection, satellite assignment, and observation sequencing under satellite-dependent visibility windows, attitude maneuvering requirements, energy consumption, and onboard storage constraints. Since satellites differ in orbital access, maneuvering capability, and payload resources, the same task may have different feasible windows, transition costs, and resource-consumption patterns on different platforms, which increases the difficulty of unified modeling and efficient optimization. To address this problem, this paper proposes an evolutionary policy optimization framework for heterogeneous AEOS scheduling with preference-adjustable weighted objectives. translated_title: 强化学习引导的进化策略优化用于偏好可调的异构敏捷对地观测卫星调度
translated_abstract: 异构敏捷对地观测卫星（AEOS）调度需要在卫星相关的可见窗口、姿态机动要求、能量消耗和星上存储约束下，进行任务选择、卫星分配和观测排序。由于卫星在轨道访问、机动能力和载荷资源方面存在差异，同一任务在不同平台上可能具有不同的可行窗口、过渡成本和资源消耗模式，这增加了统一建模和高效优化的难度。为解决此问题，本文提出了一种用于异构AEOS调度的进化策略优化框架，具有偏好可调的加权目标。在建模层，基于分配的间接编码与基于解码器的等效成本评估相结合，以保留卫星相关约束，同时整合任务收益、节能和负载均衡。
tldr: 本文提出了一种强化学习引导的进化策略优化框架，通过偏好可调的加权目标有效解决异构敏捷对地观测卫星调度中的复杂约束和优化难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-guided evolutionary policy optimization framework with preference-adjustable weighted objectives to effectively solve complex constraints and optimization challenges in heterogeneous agile Earth observation satellite scheduling.
